capabilities: Manage tasks as cards on a Kanban board with drag-and-drop between columns
Render Markdown content, links, images, and frontmatter metadata on cards
Track sub-task checklists and progress percentages on card covers
Open Markdown files as Kanban boards based on frontmatter metadata
Decorate the board with a mouse-reactive dot-pattern background
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also covers installation via BRAT and troubleshooting for boards not displaying and drag-and-drop lag.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in Kanban view, so tracking tasks through stages requires editing plain Markdown lists by hand.
summary: Visual Kanban board that manages tasks as draggable cards across columns, with Markdown card previews, checklists, and progress bars.
